QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable simulation object receiver
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Receive read-only simulation object traffic on an explicit UDP socket.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: suppressVehicleConnectedPopups
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Suppress informational vehicle connection dialogs in simulation mode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: When the simulation object receiver is enabled, avoid the noncritical Connected to Vehicle popup. Other warnings remain enabled.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: bindAddress
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation listener interface
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Numeric local IP address. Use 0.0.0.0 only with a trusted peer allow-list.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: allowedSender
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Trusted simulation sender IP
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Exact numeric source IP, not a hostname.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: completedRetentionMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Completed missile retention (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How long to retain an explicitly ended simulation object.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: staleTimeoutMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation stale threshold (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Network staleness based on monotonic receive time.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: removalTimeoutMs
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Simulation stale removal (ms)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Remove stale objects from the active model without considering them completed.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trailEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable trails
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show this category's recent map trajectory.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trailLifetimeSec
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Unlimited,1 second,3 seconds,5 seconds,10 seconds,15 seconds,30 seconds,60 seconds
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Trail lifetime
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Rolling monotonic-time history; unlimited is capped at 2048 samples per object.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trailStyle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Trail style
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Fading gradually dims older trail segments.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trailClearWhenStopped
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Clear trail when stationary
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Off: stationary trails expire normally. On: clear immediately when a stopped motion state or low ground speed is reported.
